Government and CJP Hold Talks Amid NEET Exam Controversy

The Central government and the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) held discussions regarding the NEET exam controversy. Following the talks, BJP President J.P. Nadda and CJP representatives held a press conference. While Nadda stated the government is ready for parliamentary discussion on the NEET paper leak and accused the opposition of playing politics, CJP's specific demands were not met, according to some reports. Delhi Police have initiated an investigation into speeches made during a CJP protest. Separately, Delhi Police announced that liquor stores would close at 8 PM on weekends due to the CJP protest.
